name: Theobroma Bakery and Cake Shop - Bhayander West
description: Theobroma translates to 'Food of the Gods' in Greek, fit for our indulgent and exclusive range of products. Our offerings include gooey fudgy brownies, indulgent cakes, rich chocolates, decadent desserts, freshly baked breads, viennoiserie, wholesome savouries and fresh beverages, along with festive and seasonal products . Theobroma is now a pan-India patisserie chain with presence in Bhayander West. We believe in spreading happiness by serving smiles on a plate and hope to continue doing so as we open patisseries across the country. Our Bhayander West is open from 8 Am to 11 Pm for dine-in, delivery and takeaway. You can get your hands on freshly baked 'Food of the Gods' every day at our Bhayander West outlet.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pearl Cakes in Bhayander (West), Thane is located near 60 ft Road, opposite Aparna Co‑Op Housing. The shop appears to be a boutique/custom cake shop rather than a large bakery chain, which gives it a more personalized feel.

From photos, they seem to offer decorative, themed cakes (e.g. cartoon, fondant work) and cupcakes. The visual presentation is decent, with attention to color and designs.

Aesthetic / Decoration
The cake designs are visually appealing. From the photos, they seem capable of customizing themes, fondant decor, and detailed work. For occasions (birthdays, kids’ themes), this is a big plus.

Local Reputation & Accessibility
Being in Bhayander, they serve the local community conveniently. The fact that they show up in local listings and have positive ratings indicates people are aware of them and use their services.

Service Hours / Flexibility
They are listed as open until 10:00 pm. A later closing time can help for last-minute orders or pickups.

Pearl Cakes, Bhayander seems to be a promising option for decorative, custom cakes in the Bhayander area. Its strengths lie in its aesthetic sense, local presence, and apparently good customer ratings. I'd recommend you should sample a smaller order first (birthday cake, small custom) before entrusting them with large or critical orders (like a wedding cake).

featured_reviews.name: Hrishikesh Khaire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday on 23rd July 2024, I went to the shop to purchase cake, i saw Lotus Biscoff for the very first time.( i am a consumer of this cake shop past 3 years ) since Lotus Biscoff is not available in nearby cake shops in bhayander i was surprised and i asked to pack the cake for me. I legit confirmed it from the sales person that is this lotus Biscoff cheesecake only and he undoubtedly said yes it's that ( as from the appearance it seemed to be lotus Biscoff cheesecake, i will attach the photos for the reference). He said me it's worth ₹500/- 1/2 kg i took it and it turned out to be just a normal cake with sponge inside. Just to make you fool from the appearance they had placed 2 lotus Biscoff biscuits above the cake with the brown caramel and cream on the top as dressing. That's how they're fooling in the name of Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake and giving the normal cake with wipped cream and caramel and selling it at ₹500/- that's fraudulent and people should know it and hence i have posted this review. Other cakes are good and upto the mark but this is what i found to be a misleading selling practice and hence i posted the review.

Souffle and the admin should take this review and tell their salesperson to provide the right information about the cakes and sell them with the right name.
